title: pteris aquilina var. lanuginosa
intro: Pteris aquilina var. lanuginosa, commonly known as the woolly bracken fern, is a variant of the Pteris aquilina species, a type of fern native to Asia and Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pteris aquilina var. lanuginosa include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating conditions such as arthritis, indigestion, and wound infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been identified through various studies on its chemical composition.
